content: Academy Award winner Nicolas Cage returns as the notorious arms dealer Yuri Orlov, who discovers that a ruthless mercenary (Bill Skarsgård) is bent on destroying his legacy, thrusting them into a blood-soaked and bullet-riddled battle to the death. Starring: Nicolas Cage & Bill Skarsgård Directed by: Andrew Niccol Release Date: January 22, 2027 #vertical #movie #movietrailers
chineseContent: 奥斯卡金像奖得主尼古拉斯·凯奇回归，饰演臭名昭著的军火商尤里·奥尔洛夫，他发现一名无情的雇佣兵（比尔·斯卡斯加德饰）一心要毁掉他的遗产，并将他们推入一场血淋淋、枪林弹雨的殊死搏斗。主演：尼古拉斯·凯奇和比尔·斯卡斯加德 导演：安德鲁·尼科尔 上映日期：2027 年 1 月 22 日 #vertical #movie #movietrailers
